Copy 115 Daily Report of Officer in Charge of Dixwell Road Police Station.

Monday 22 / 3 / 37.

ASSISTANCE TO
S.C.G.P.B.
At 4.35 p.m. 21-3-37 J.P.S. 112 brought to Station a Chinese named Tsau Hai Pau, age 19, S/Carpenter residing O.O.L. whom he had arrested on Darroch Road in possession of one electric meter believed to have been stolen. Enquiries at the Station revealed that the man had stolen same from an unoccupied house in the Fong Loh Li alleyway O.O.L. On instructions from the D. O. the accused together with the property was handed over to the S.C.G.P.B. North Szechuen Road.

ASSISTANCE TO
S.C.G.P.B.
At 11.25 p.m. 21-3-37 a telephone message was received from the North Szechuen Road Station, S.C.G.P.B. reporting having arrested three French soldiers and three Koreans for fighting on Jukong Road and requesting that they be taken over by the S.M.P. S.I. Jetstall, D.S. Young and J.D.S. 137 attended and brought all concerned to this Station. Inspector Power Chen of the S.C.G.P.B. stated that a quarrel had started in Jukong Road evidently by the soldiers who had just previously left the Red Rose cabaret, during which one of the Koreans had sustained injuries, which resulted in all the parties being placed under arrest by members of the S.C.G.P.B. The French Police were informed and joint investigations made by them at the scene of the affray. The injured Korean was taken to the Foo Ming Hospital where his injuries were found to be not serious "Contused wounds on face, Excoriation of the head". There were no police witnesses and the Japanese Consular Police who also attended stated that if the French soldiers would agree to pay the sum of $14.00 as medical expenses they would consider the matter closed. This was agreed upon and the money paid, a receipt being issued by the Consular Police whilst the soldiers were handed over to Sgt. Choquet and D.C. Toporoff attached to Central Station of the French Police at 2.30 a.m. 22-3-37.

（印：SPECIAL BRANCH 22 MAR. 1937 SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

狄思威路捕房主管警官每日报告副本 115。

1937年3月22日，星期一。

协助
华界公安局。
1937年3月21日下午4时35分，第112号华籍警员将一名名为 Tsau Hai Pau 的中国人带至捕房，此人19岁，职业木匠，居住在老闸区（O.O.L.）。该警员在大西路（Darroch Road）将其逮捕，当时他持有一个疑似被盗的电表。在捕房进行的查询显示，此人是从老闸区丰乐里弄堂内的一间空屋中偷窃了该电表。根据代理警官的指示，被告连同赃物已被移交给华界公安局北四川路捕房。

协助
华界公安局。
1937年3月21日晚上11时25分，接获华界公安局北四川路捕房电话通知，报告称因在掘根路（Jukong Road）斗殴而逮捕了三名法国士兵和三名朝鲜人，并请求由上海公共租界工部局警务处接管。巡官 Jetstall、副巡官 Young 和第137号华人侦探主任到场，将所有相关人员带至本捕房。华界公安局督察 Power Chen 称，争吵显然由刚刚离开红玫瑰歌舞厅（Red Rose cabaret）的士兵挑起，期间一名朝鲜人受伤，导致所有当事人被华界公安局警员逮捕。已通知法国警察署，并由他们在斗殴现场进行联合调查。受伤的朝鲜人被送往福民医院，经查伤势不重，“面部挫伤，头部擦伤”。没有警方证人，到场的日本领事馆警察也表示，如果法国士兵同意支付14.00元作为医疗费，他们将视此事为已结。双方达成此协议并支付了款项，领事馆警察出具了收据，而士兵们则于1937年3月22日凌晨2时30分移交给隶属于法国警察署中央捕房的 Choquet 警长和 Toporoff 侦探主任。

（印：特科 1937年3月22日 上海公共租界工部局警务处）

“C”分区代理警官。
